comment: One CC assignment per line of telemetry. BOTH the firmware header and the host decoder are generated from this file, so they cannot drift apart -- the failure that made a day of page readings meaningless on 2026-09-23.

signals.name: track
signals.note: the index the tick was handed

signals.name: dest
signals.note: the destination code in the row

signals.name: voice
signals.note: the voice, when a caller knows it

signals.name: probe_a
signals.note: unassigned, for whatever is being chased

signals.name: marker
signals.note: a caller-chosen tag, to separate call sites
